svg.text: CVA6 RAW ALU-to-ALU Operand Forwarding Burst (Cycles 276 – 294)
Back-to-back execution of dependent ALU instructions (x4 -> x5 -> x6 -> x7 -> x8 -> x9 -> x10). Operand bypass eliminates stall bubbles, sustaining CPI = 1.00.

At cycles 280, 281, and 282, instructions ADD x5, SUB x6, and AND x7 retire on consecutive cycles. Although each instruction requires the previous instruction's output register, Rs1HasRaw=1 and ForwardRs1=1 bypass data directly from the writeback bus, keeping StallRaw=0 and issue unblocked.
